scope.memory_policy: Shared 32-bit modules: 128 KiB two-rank 16K×1 modules preserve Athena 256 KiB; 256 KiB single-rank 2 µm 64K×1 modules preserve Server 1 MiB. Two modules per independently selected 32-bit capacity bank; qualification pending.

scope.external_application_rom_cards: No external cartridge slots added; system ROM is distinct from optional application cartridges.
